purpose: Teach: 八つ/裁き/如実/無敵/メリハリ/如き/へそ/爺さん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが八つの紙風船を作って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad made eight paper balloons for us.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle lift on the gift itself. Speaking to a child with affection. Clear, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、悪い行いには裁きがあるって学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I learned that bad things have consequences.
lines.style: Quiet, serious conviction. Small voice carrying a big thought. Pauses slightly, like he's working it out aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの優しさが如実に伝わるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's kindness really shows through in everything he does.
lines.style: Tender warmth, noticing something true about him. Soft emphasis on the kindness. Speaking with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんは無敵だって思うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I think Dad is invincible.
lines.style: Complete faith without drama. Small voice, big belief. The certainty of childhood admiration, no doubt underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはお仕事とお休みのメリハリがあるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad knows how to switch between work and rest. He has that balance.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, a bit wistful. Noticing something adult about it. Slower pace, reflective.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの如き紳士になりたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I want to be a gentleman like Dad someday.
lines.style: Sincere aspiration, a little formal with the word 'gentleman.' Not perform, but earnest. Small, clear voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、温泉でお父さんがへそ出しの浴衣でくつろいでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho — at the hot spring, your dad was just relaxing in his yukata with his belly out.
lines.style: Amused observation, slight wryness. Not mocking—noticing the human, funny side of him. Light, almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんを「爺さん」って呼んだら怒られちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — when I called Grandpa 'old man,' he got really mad at me.
lines.style: Rueful, a bit sheepish. The humor of getting caught doing something cheeky. Small laugh underneath. Lesson learned.
